entities.description: An elderly person is standing in a bedroom, wearing a light blue button-up shirt with rolled-up sleeves and beige pants. The person is holding a wooden cane with their right hand, and their left hand is resting by their side. In the background, there is a bed with white bedding and a wooden headboard.

attributes.pose: standing, holding cane with right hand

entities.description: A small, round wooden side table with three tapered legs, featuring a light natural wood finish and a minimalist design. The tabletop holds a black camera and a partially visible glass object.

A light-colored wooden bookshelf with a simple, rectangular frame design is visible in the background, holding a row of white or light-colored books or binders on a middle shelf. The wood appears to be a natural finish, possibly oak or birch, and the structure is partially obscured by the foreground figures.

An elderly woman with short, wavy white hair stands with a somber expression, looking downward while holding a wooden cane in her right hand. She wears a light blue button-down shirt with rolled-up sleeves and beige trousers, while a caregiver in a blue uniform places a comforting hand on her shoulder.

A young Asian woman with dark hair tied back in a ponytail and wearing glasses is dressed in a light blue short-sleeved medical scrub set. She stands to the left, looking down with a gentle expression, placing her hands on the shoulders of an elderly woman.
